content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Container:** Centered modal dialog, approx. **[206, 16] to [778, 836]** (572px wide x 820px high). Rounded corners (approx. 8-10px radius), white background.
*   **Header Region:** Centered icon and text block. Icon at approx. **[470, 75]** (48x48px). Headline text centered below it at **[342, 175]** to **[642, 200]**. Subtext centered below headline at **[340, 215]** to **[644, 235]**.
*   **Tab Bar:** Horizontal segmented control below subtext, approx. **[246, 265]** to **[738, 305]**. Divided into two equal halves: "Local" (left) and "Cloud" (right).
*   **Destination List:** Scrollable container below tabs, approx. **[246, 315]** to **[738, 750]**. Contains three selectable rows of uniform height (~80px each).
    *   *Row 1:* Windows (C:) drive option.
    *   *Row 2:* Temporary Storage (D:) drive option (selected state).
    *   *Row 3:* "Choose folder..." custom path option.
*   **Footer Region:** Spans the bottom width of the dialog content area (**[246, 765]** to **[738, 815]**).
    *   Left: Toggle switch + label ("Enable file repair").
    *   Right: Primary action button ("Save").

### 2. TEXT
**Dialog Header:**
*   `Choose a destination path to save the file:` (Centered, Bold)
*   `You have 1139246 file(s) (146.41 GB) to recover.` (Centered, Regular)

**Tabs:**
*   `Local` (Selected)
*   `Cloud`

**Drive List:**
*   Row 1: `Windows (C:)`, `31.32 GB/149.45 GB`
*   Row 2: `Temporary Storage (D:)`, `146.07 GB/150 GB`
*   Row 3: `Choose folder...`

**Footer:**
*   `Enable file repair`
*   `Save`

*(Background App Text - Visible through overlay):*
*   Top Left: `Path`, `Windows (C:)`, `File Path Lost`, `Reconstructed`
*   Top Right: `Search files or folders`, `ghcup`, `Open`
*   Details Pane: `Size`, `4.23 GB`, `Date Modified`, `10/8/2026 12:32 AM`, `Path`, `C:\`
*   Bottom Status Bar: `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139246 (146.41 GB)`, `Selected: 1139246 files (146.41 GB)`, `Recover`
*   System Tray: `7:28 PM`, `10/17/2026`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Dialog Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Modal Overlay/Backdrop: `#000000` at ~40% opacity (darkening the main app window)
    *   Tab Active Background: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Tab Inactive Background: `#F0F0F0` or `#EFEFEF`
    *   List Item Selected Background: `#E8F0FE` (Light Blue)
    *   List Item Hover/Normal Background: `#FAFAFA` or transparent white
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings): `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Subtext): `#5F6368` (Dark Grey)
    *   Drive Capacity Text: `#5F6368`
    *   Button Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Action Button: `#1677FF` (Bright Blue) / `#0958D9` (Darker blue for hover/border)
    *   Selection Circle Fill: `#1677FF`
    *   Warning Icon (Row 1 - Red): `#FF4D4F`
    *   Warning Icon (Row 2 - Yellow): `#FAAD14`
    *   Toggle Track (Off): `#CCCCCC`
    *   Toggle Thumb: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Borders (Tabs/List container): `#D9D9D9` (Light Grey)

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Headline ("Choose a destination..."):** Segoe UI (or system sans-serif), ~14px, **Bold (600/700)**.
*   **Subtext ("You have..."):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular (400).
*   **Tab Labels:** Segoe UI, ~13px, **Medium/Semi-bold (500)** when active, Regular when inactive.
*   **List Items (Drive Name):** Segoe UI, ~13px, **Medium (500)**.
*   **List Items (Capacity):** Segoe UI, ~11px or 12px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Medium.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~30-40px on all sides.
*   **Icon Size:** 48x48px (Folder icon in header).
*   **Row Height:** ~76-80px per list item.
*   **Radio Button Diameter:** ~18-20px.
*   **Drive Icon Size:** 32x32px (inside list rows).
*   **Button Dimensions:** Width ~100px, Height ~36px (Standard Windows control height).
*   **Toggle Switch:** Width ~44px, Height ~22px.
*   **Gutters:** ~12-16px padding inside list items between icon/radio/text.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Close Button ('X'):** Top-right corner of dialog. State: Normal.
*   **Segmented Control (Tabs):**
    *   "Local": **Selected/Active**. White background, subtle shadow or border indication.
    *   "Cloud": **Inactive/Disabled-looking** (Grey background). Likely disabled because no cloud account is connected or feature is locked.
*   **Radio Buttons (List Rows):**
    *   Row 1 (Windows C:): **Unselected**. Empty circle outline.
    *   Row 2 (Temp D:): **Selected**. Solid blue circle with white dot/checkmark. Row background is highlighted light blue.
    *   Row 3 (Choose folder): **Unselected**. Empty circle outline.
*   **Warning Icons:**
    *   Row 1: Red triangle exclamation mark (Indicates insufficient space or system drive warning).
    *   Row 2: Yellow triangle exclamation mark (Indicates low space warning).
*   **Toggle Switch ("Enable file repair"):** **State: OFF**. Slider positioned to the left. Track is grey.
*   **Action Button ("Save"):** **State: ENABLED**. Solid blue background, white text. No visible disable styling (opacity/grey-out).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Modern Windows style (Acrylic/Glass-lite feel). Mix of Filled and Outline.
*   **Header Icon:** Filled folder icon with a blue document/graphic element inside. Isometric perspective.
*   **Drive Icons (List):**
    *   Windows (C:): Standard HDD/SSD icon (Silver/Grey isometric).
    *   Temporary Storage (D:): Standard HDD icon (Silver/Grey isometric).
    *   Choose Folder: Standard Yellow Folder icon (Isometric).
*   **Status Icons:**
    *   Warnings: Standard triangular warning icons (Outline/Filled hybrid).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Partial Success / Pre-action Confirmation**.
    *   The user has completed a scan (Background shows "Scan Completed").
    *   The user is now at the "Export/Save" configuration step.
    *   A destination has been pre-selected (Temporary Storage D:).
    *   **Warnings Present:** The interface explicitly warns about storage conditions (Red warning on C:, Yellow warning on D:). This suggests the user might be running into space issues, but the "Save" button remains enabled, implying they can proceed (perhaps with risk or partial recovery).
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
